annotations.title: Company data lookup: profile, identifiers and website from Wikidata

description: Facts about a company by name or Wikidata ID: official website, founding date, country, headquarters, industries, CEO, founders, parent, employee count, stock tickers and exchanges, and LEI, with Wikidata and Wikipedia links. Public domain data (CC0), best for established and listed companies. No match returns 404, uncharged. Use to enrich leads, vendors and counterparties or ground an answer about a company. Example: name=Spotify. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
